metadata.description: Official Kismet plugin marketplace for operators and developers. Operator skill content is mirrored from kismet-infrastructure skills-src by CI; developer guidance is grounded in the public Developer MCP.

plugins.name: kismet-operators
plugins.description: Kismet for Operators — the authenticated workspace for running your Kismet business from your AI: curate catalogs, analyze guest journeys, run the guest CRM (search guests, audiences, notes), generate demand, run Insiders email, manage ads and audiences, configure automations, and produce the client-facing Booking Channel & Group Performance report.

plugins.name: kismet-developer
plugins.description: Kismet for Developers: build and validate branded sites with the Developer API, SDK, Fixtures, and agent-readable contracts.
